basis: Completed bounded fresh consumer, exact ordinary prompts, actual fixtures/artifacts, public native invocation identities, source transport logs and read-only native database snapshot.
packageOnly: Construct MCP executes directly from the freshly installed package. No checkout logging wrapper. The external fixture orchestrator imports checkout helper functions for subscription environment and TOML formatting; these are not consumer dependencies.
instrumentation: Explicit MCP attachment and sterile Construct environment isolate synthetic source access. This does not test automatic import of arbitrary user connections, production authentication or untouched global host configuration.
limits: Requested correction is not autonomous change detection. Fixture authority/supersession warnings do not prove unfamiliar inference. Source/application reports retain their reported assurance. Private reasoning and claim tokens omitted.
